none: PAS LIN-594661: LIN-594661: Roman coin of H. of Constantine, nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine (AD 306-337), dating to the period AD 330-331 (Reece Period 17). Wolf and twins reverse type. Obverse VRBS ROMA. Mint of Trier. Probably as RIC VII, p.215, no.529. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left wearing imperial cloak. Obverse inscription: VRBS-ROMA. Reverse description: She-Wolf suckling Twins. Mintmark: //TRP. Diameter: 14.67 mm; Weight: 2.03g
